podcast.body: This song from the album "Frankenstein Girls Will Seem Strangely Sexy" contains the line "Play That Record Backwards." Two minutes into the song, a backward message from singer Jimmy Euren is heard, intended to "mess with people" and counter "satanic panickers." "It leads off with a song called Back Mask Warning and it contains the line, Play That Record Backwards."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
